∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {d m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      0 < n →
        outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.largeSample m n →
          ∀ (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
            (rows : Ω → ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow)
            (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ) (τ : Fin n → ENNReal),
            Monotone τ →
              ∀
                (answer :
                  ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → Ω → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
                Measurable rows →
                  (∀ (a : ℕ), Measurable fun z => answer a z.1 z.2) →
                    (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂↑P, outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => answer a r ω) →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.FullFresh P n (List.ofFn id) x start rows answer →
                        ∫⁻ (ω : Ω),
                            ↑((outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n (List.ofFn id) x start (rows ω)
                                    (fun a r => answer a r ω) (n * m)).clock -
                                start) ∂↑P ≤
                          5 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑m
